RiskAuditGuide.title: Check the listing for free
RiskAuditGuide.subtitle: Send a link and get a first take on whether this car is even worth looking at.

step1.question: Where has the car mainly been used?
step1.hint: Local-market and imported-car risks differ — this helps us evaluate the listing more precisely.

step2.title: Recommended service
step2.hint: Even for cars used in Latvia for years, local registries don’t show the full history — for example hidden accidents before import, true mileage, or visual contradictions in the listing.
step2.auditsBody: Full listing, photo and vehicle history check in international paid databases + our final conclusion.
step2.miniBody: Basic data check without deep history analysis.
step2.miniWarning: PROVIN MINI does not include vehicle history checks in paid databases, and does not provide full listing and photo risk analysis.

form.title: Free 3–5 sentence review
form.boundary: Public listing only — not an audit and not a consultation. Reply by email in 24–48h.

success.title: Request received.
success.body: We’ll reply within 24–48h with a short look at the listing. If you need full history — PROVIN AUDITS is the next step.
